method: Alternating serial fresh processes, identical input bytes. Wall time excludes imports. RSS is max(parent, largest child), not concurrent total. limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; no independent real-sample validation.
Confidence scores and observation envelopes are not calibrated probabilities or confidence intervals.
RSS is maximum of parent and largest child, not concurrent total.
Input copies preserve error patterns and are not independent sequencing replicates.
Ablations isolate three optional mechanisms, not every coupled recruitment/correctness change.
